Ava (People Ops): Quick update on the annual attestation window 1 1 1 We have a hard freeze for attestation artifacts next Friday 11:59 PM PT. Please surface any exception requests now.

Sam (Legal): Reminder: contractors with access to Prod need signed NDAs on file to be included in SOC2 scope. If you have contractors, drop names here.

Nina (Compliance): For ISO, we need the incident response tabletop notes from Q4. Short meeting minutes + action items are sufficient (no recordings).

Derek (Eng): Can we get a standard exception template? Some teams are asking for short (48h) extensions but we need a consistent format.

Ava (People Ops): Yes 1 use the template `attestation-exception-template.md` in the Audit Toolkit space. Required fields: owner, reason, duration, mitigation, approver. Post the filled template to Confluence and tag `iso:exception` or `soc2:exception`.

Sam (Legal): Approvers for data-scope exceptions: Sam (Legal) + Nina (Compliance). Security exceptions still go to Jon (Security) too.

Nina (Compliance): Quick policy note: extended retention exceptions (>6 months) need a privacy impact assessment attached. Ping me if you need a hand.

Derek (Eng): Uploading a stub of our deployment change logs now. Will follow with redacted job traces by EOD.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks. Also running a short voluntary "attestation standup" tomorrow 9:30 AM PT for teams with open items. Join if you want triage help. Calendar invite coming. :calendar:

evidence-bot: Progress snapshot: 17 teams complete, 9 teams with partial uploads, 4 open exception requests. Auto-reminder scheduled 48h before freeze. Link: https://redwood.internal/evidence/dashboard (internal).

Ava (People Ops): If you cannot meet the freeze, post an exception request here before 5 PM PT Wednesday with the template filled out. We'll review same day. If you already submitted, please add the Confluence link to your request. :slightly_smiling_face:
